{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the premises
print("Shape:", sales.shape)
print("Unique customer_segment values:", sales['customer_segment'].unique())
print("Unique status values:", sales['status'].unique())
print("Distribution of status:", sales['status'].value_counts())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of -1 in customer_age:", (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue: is it string? does it have commas?
print("Sample of revenue:", sales['revenue'].head())
print("Revenue dtype:", sales['revenue'].dtype)

# Check for QA orders
print("Number of rows with revenue == '999999.99':", (sales['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())"}
